title: Safety Footwear for Industrial Workers
qco_name: Safety Footwear for Industrial Workers (Quality Control Mandatory Order)
source_authority: Bureau of Indian Standards / Gazette of India

clauses.title: Specification & Requirements Part 1
clauses.text:
Clause 5.3 Impact Resistance: Safety footwear steel toe-caps shall withstand an impact energy of at least 200 Joules without clearance falling below 14 mm.

Clause 5.4 Penetration Resistance: Puncture-resistant midsoles must withstand nail penetration force of at least 1100 Newtons.

Clause 6.1 Antistatic and Slip Resistance: Outsole must exhibit dynamic coefficient of friction > 0.32 on ceramic tile with sodium lauryl sulphate lubricant.
